description.ja: 『スーパーロボット大戦OG』シリーズより根強い人気を誇る「ダイゼンガー」が、大張正己氏によるアニメ版デザインでHGシリーズに見参！
description.en: "Daizengar ", which is more popular than the " Super Robot Wars OG" series, is now available in the HG series with an anime version designed by Masami Obari!

description.ja: ■「参式斬艦刀」は通常時、展開時の2種類が付属。
description.en: • Two types of "Sanshiki Zankanto" are included: normal and deployed.

description.ja: ■「ダイナミック・ナックル」や「ゼネラル・ブラスター」など各種必殺技を迫力あるポージングで表現可能！
description.en: • Various special moves such as "Dynamic Knuckle " and " General Blaster" can be expressed with powerful poses!

description.ja: ■こだわりの成形色とパーツ分割により、シールレスで機体カラーを再現。組み立てるだけでカラフルな仕上がり。
description.en: • The aircraft color is reproduced without seals using carefully selected molding colors and parts division. Colorful finish just by assembly.

description.ja: ■背部が展開しスラスターの露出が可能。
description.en: • The back can be expanded to expose the thrusters.

description.ja: ■専用持ち手など各種ハンドパーツやディスプレイベースが付属。
description.en: • Various hand parts such as special handles and display base are included.
